<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Artist Rexy – Illustrations by Touhid Hridoy</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#F8F0F4;--ink:#3A1D2A;--muted:#7A5A68;--accent:#C4283C;--t1:#F9DCE4;--t2:#D9EEF0;--t3:#E8DDF5;--line:#E6CFD9;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#1F1219;--ink:#F7E8EF;--muted:#C9A8B8;--accent:#FF6B80;--line:#43283A}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#1F1219;--ink:#F7E8EF;--muted:#C9A8B8;--accent:#FF6B80;--line:#43283A}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1rem/1.6 "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:32px;align-items:center;padding:56px 0 40px}
h1,h2{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,9vw,6rem);line-height:.95;color:var(--accent)}
.lead{font-size:1.15rem;max-width:30em;color:var(--muted);margin:20px 0 0}
.hero-art{background:var(--t1);border-radius:50%;aspect-ratio:1;padding:6%;display:grid;place-items:center}
.hero-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
section{padding:36px 0}
h2{font-size:1.7rem;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px}
h2 small{font:400 .95rem "DM Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px}
.tile{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer;display:block;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;background:var(--tint);text-align:center}
.tile:focus-visible,.x:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.tile img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.tile span{display:block;color:#3A1D2A;font-size:.9rem;margin-top:8px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:24px;padding-top:40px}
.about p{margin:0 0 14px;max-width:34em}
.note{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding-left:14px}
footer{padding:28px 0 40px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
dialog{border:0;border-radius:20px;padding:20px;width:min(92vw,760px);background:#fff;color:#3A1D2A;text-align:center}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(30,10,20,.7)}
dialog img{width:100%;max-height:75vh;object-fit:contain}
.x{position:absolute;top:10px;right:14px;font-size:1.8rem;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;color:#3A1D2A}
@media (max-width:720px){.hero,.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-art{max-width:340px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
<header class="hero">
 <div>
  <h1>Artist Rexy</h1>
  <p class="lead">Digital illustrations by Touhid Hridoy: red roses, glossy hearts and gentle little animals, made as clean transparent PNGs for cards, crafts, prints and social posts.</p>
 </div>
 <div class="hero-art"><img id="heroimg" alt="Cupid angel holding a bouquet of red roses"></div>
</header>
<main id="gallery"></main>
<section class="about">
 <div>
  <h2>About</h2>
  <p>Hi, I’m Touhid Hridoy, the artist behind Artist Rexy. I create soft watercolor and glossy 3D-style illustrations with a focus on Valentine’s themes, roses, hearts and cute animal characters.</p>
  <p>Every piece is exported on a transparent background at 2500 × 2500 px, so designers, teachers, crafters and small shops can drop it straight into their own work.</p>
 </div>
 <div>
  <h2>How I work</h2>
  <p class="note">My illustrations are created with AI image tools and then selected, cleaned up and prepared by me, including background removal and export. They are labeled as AI-generated wherever a platform asks for it.</p>
 </div>
</section>
<footer>© Artist Rexy · Touhid Hridoy</footer>
</div>
<dialog id="lb"><button class="x" aria-label="Close">×</button><img alt=""><p></p></dialog>
<script>
var items=[
{t:"Watercolor heart rose bouquet",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Red and gold rose bouquet",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Red rose heart",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Cupid angel with red roses",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Rose and gold heart collection",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Red watercolor rose with gold heart",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Pink and white rose heart wreath",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Roses and peonies in a glass vase",g:0,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Lamb with rose bouquet and heart bow",g:1,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Panda with lavender bow",g:1,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Baby fox with teacup",g:1,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Bunny smelling a peony",g:1,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Happy Valentine’s wood plaque",g:2,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Coral and turquoise heart garland",g:2,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
{t:"Pink and purple heart ornaments",g:2,s:"data:image/webp;base64,"}];
var groups=[["Roses and hearts","var(--t1)"],["Little animals","var(--t2)"],["Valentine decor","var(--t3)"]];
var lb=document.getElementById("lb"),lbi=lb.querySelector("img"),lbp=lb.querySelector("p");
document.getElementById("heroimg").src=items[3].s;
var out=document.getElementById("gallery");
groups.forEach(function(G,gi){
 var list=items.filter(function(i){return i.g===gi});
 var sec=document.createElement("section");
 sec.innerHTML="<h2>"+G[0]+" <small>"+list.length+" illustrations</small></h2>";
 var grid=document.createElement("div");grid.className="grid";
 list.forEach(function(i){
  var b=document.createElement("button");b.className="tile";b.style.setProperty("--tint",G[1]);
  b.innerHTML='<img alt="'+i.t+'"><span>'+i.t+'</span>';
  b.querySelector("img").src=i.s;
  b.onclick=function(){lbi.src=i.s;lbi.alt=i.t;lbp.textContent=i.t;lb.showModal()};
  grid.appendChild(b)});
 sec.appendChild(grid);out.appendChild(sec)});
lb.querySelector(".x").onclick=function(){lb.close()};
lb.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target===lb)lb.close()});
</script>
</body>
</html>
